name: Taming the Beast

angles.text: As a hunter, you move beyond tracking and toward a deeper, more understanding bond with wild beasts.
As a human hunter training in Elwynn Forest, you learn to live alongside the kingdom’s natural predators instead of trying to destroy them.
As an Alliance beast master, you can give wilderness scouts disciplined companions to defend homesteads and patrol trade roads across Stormwind’s territories.

faq.answer: Josephine Carson assigns the trial to hunters training in Elwynn Forest. After they tame lesser beasts, she gives them guidance and the Taming Rod for the forest bear. When the trial is done, they return the rod to her.
faq.q: Who assigns this trial to hunters?

aliases: what did i tame before bear
faq.answer: Hunters first tame a boar and a wolf before facing a Young Forest Bear. Those trials show they can handle resilient and pack-oriented beasts before attempting to earn a bear’s trust.
faq.q: Which beasts must be tamed before this challenge?

faq.answer: A Young Forest Bear tests a hunter against the brawn and might of Elwynn Forest’s wildlife. After handling the quick wolf and resilient boar, the hunter must show endurance, respect, and courage to earn the bear’s trust.
faq.q: Why are hunters sent after a Young Forest Bear?

faq.answer: Josephine Carson gives hunters a Taming Rod to help calm wild animals. It helps soothe an aggressive Young Forest Bear without killing it and lets the hunter form a peaceful bond. Hunters return the rod to Carson when the trial is complete.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Taming Rod?

faq.answer: Hunters learn to preserve Elwynn Forest’s natural balance by treating wildlife with respect and restraint. They guide dangerous beasts peacefully instead of hunting them down, preserving harmony between local wildlife and humanoid settlements.
faq.q: How does taming beasts help Elwynn Forest?

aliases: what happens after taming the bear
faq.answer: Completing the final trial deepens a hunter’s bond with wild beasts. Earning the trust of Elwynn’s mightiest creature teaches the understanding needed for lifelong partnerships with animal companions across Azeroth.
faq.q: What does completing this lesson signify for a hunter?

aliases: where to find bears in elwynn
faq.answer: Young Forest Bears roam the wooded areas of Elwynn Forest, among dense trees and alongside wolves and spiders. Hunters leave nearby settlements and track the bears through the undergrowth, following Carson’s final direction with the Taming Rod.
faq.q: Where are Young Forest Bears found?

sections.body: Hunters in Elwynn Forest learn to live among the wild creatures around them. After taming a wolf and a boar, they face one last test of courage and patience. Josephine Carson sends each hunter to a Young Forest Bear, the strongest of the forest’s common predators. The hunter must endure the bear’s strength and earn its trust, rather than force it to submit.
sections.title: The Final Trial of the Hunt

sections.body: Taming wildlife in Elwynn calls for respect, not dominion. Forest bears embody the woodland’s strength and vitality, and help keep its natural order. With a Taming Rod, hunters learn to calm a bear’s aggression and form a bond through understanding. Earning the trust of such a powerful animal deepens a hunter’s bond with the wild and completes the first lessons Josephine Carson oversees.
sections.title: Respect and Balance in Elwynn

summary: In Elwynn Forest, hunters face Taming the Beast, the final trial Josephine Carson oversees. After taming a boar and a wolf, each hunter uses a Taming Rod to earn a Young Forest Bear’s trust. The test deepens the hunter’s bond with beasts and teaches respect for the woodland’s balance.
